data.scope: Use the frozen accepted cycles. The historical QC uses file context.

split.rule: Split each anchor source file into three consecutive blocks. Hold out one block.
split.embargo: Remove ceil(n_file ** (1/3)) adjacent cycles from training.
split.shared_endpoint: Use the same role for each shared physical cycle in both systems.

cnn.amplitude_scale: Use 1.4826 times the median absolute deviation of all current training voltage values. Floor at 0.000001 V.
cnn.augmentation: Balance compositions and source files. Shift by -4 to 4 points. Scale time and amplitude by 0.98 to 1.02. Add Gaussian noise up to 0.005 times VPP.
cnn.shared_representation: Share one waveform-only CNN within each family, fold, and seed.

heads.global: Fit on all current training anchors.
heads.route: Use the same global scaler. Fit four Ridge heads on adjacent anchor pairs. Use the historical VPP router.
heads.duplicate_rule: Keep a column once when its field name is repeated. Keep distinct deterministic transforms.
heads.template: Use source templates made from current training cycles only.
heads.snr: Use cycle RMS and the robust scale of adjacent differences.
heads.ensemble: Average three outputs before clipping to 0 through 100.

baselines.OLS-V: Fit ordinary least squares to five anchor VPP medians and their compositions.
baselines.Piecewise-V: Sort the anchor medians by VPP. Merge exactly equal voltages by mean composition. Interpolate linearly. Use endpoint values outside the voltage range.

selection: Do not select a winning model or tune any setting with confirmation errors.

evaluation.method: Use paired circular blocks within each file. Keep all file counts fixed.
evaluation.scope: Condition on the fitted model and observed files. Do not infer new-film uncertainty.

freeze_order: Save the protocol and code hashes before training. Save target-free predictions before evaluation.
